description: This file contains a JavaScript module designed to enhance the display of an employment duration value in the DOM. It includes a function to convert seconds into a human-readable string format and modifies the content of an element with ID 'employment_duration' after a delay.

methods.name: displayEmployeeDuration()
methods.description: Initializes the display update for the employment duration element by converting stored seconds into a readable format and updating the DOM.

methods.name: secondsToString(seconds)
methods.description: Converts a duration in seconds into a human-readable string showing years, months, days, hours, minutes, and seconds.
